summary: Verified end-to-end that the ADA/USDT cycle-reset bug (3-fold root cause) is fixed. (1) CODE: server.py:999 and :1089 both now use `if bot.get('trade_method') == 'One-Shot'` (missing/None defaults to Cycle). (2) DB: unique compound index on (user_id,symbol) exists on db.bots (verified via index_information() AND by asserting DuplicateKeyError on a synthetic duplicate insert). Admin has exactly 1 doc per symbol for ADA/BTC/DOGE/UNI (no duplicates). (3) LIVE: admin binance_keys.mode='demo'; no 'Binance not reachable' warnings appear AFTER the last successful trade line in supervisor logs; engine actively trading (ADA first buy $20 @ 0.1768, DOGE TAKE PROFIT sold + first buy, etc.). Added /app/backend/tests/test_cycle_reset.py with 14 tests — ALL PASS (a) Cycle SELL keeps bot running + increments cycles_completed; (b) One-Shot SELL stops bot; (c) missing trade_method SELL keeps bot running; (d) None trade_method SELL keeps bot running; (e) unique index exists and is enforced; (f) admin ADA API returns status='running', trade_method='Cycle', position_qty=113.18, avg_price=0.1767, cycles_completed=1 — this PROVES cycle 2 fired after the fix; (g) BTC/DOGE also running Cycle with all fields; (h) no admin duplicate docs; (i) no post-switch 'Binance not reachable' errors; (j) live-regression 60s window observes 0-delta acceptable but count doesn't decrease. Frontend: /trades shows 4 running bots with LIVE chips, ADA/USDT card shows 'Round 1 · 2 buys · 1 sells' confirming cycle 2 in progress; clicking navigates to /pair/ADAUSDT which shows Operation Reminder with Margin Call trigger price 0.1732 (5 rounds left), Position=113.186191, Avg=0.1767, Trade Method=Cycle, Buys=2, Sells=1, Round=1. Only console errors are the pre-existing Binance WS 451 geo-restrictions (same as iteration 13). Existing suite: 112 pass, 4 pre-existing stale-fixture failures NOT caused by this iteration.

minor.issue: 7 bot docs across the DB still have trade_method missing/null (1 admin XRPUSDT stopped, 6 belonging to test-users). Not blocking because the code fix defaults missing/None to Cycle. Recommend a one-off backfill query: db.bots.updateMany({trade_method:{$in:[null]}}, {$set:{trade_method:'Cycle'}}).

Carry-over from iteration 13: the LIVE SELL branch still lacks the `avg <= 0` guard that the DEMO branch has at line 1063. If a live-mode bot ever hits SELL with avg_price=0 it would book profit=proceeds. Not triggerable in current DB state (admin is in demo mode) but should be mirrored for defence-in-depth.

These fixtures inject `avg_price=1.0, position_qty=0.001` on admin's BTCUSDT bot then SELL — producing profit≈amount SELL rows that then break test_roi_cleanup_bug.py::test_no_sell_row_has_profit_gte_95pct_of_amount. This is test-data pollution, not a runtime bug. Either raise the seed avg_price to ~0.5*current_price or lower position_qty to 0.00001, or scope the ROI check to exclude fixture-seeded rows.

action_items: OPTIONAL data hygiene: backfill trade_method='Cycle' for the 7 bot docs still missing the field (safe because code already defaults to Cycle).
OPTIONAL defence: mirror the `avg <= 0` SELL guard from demo path (server.py:1063) into the live Binance path (near server.py:976).

OPTIONAL test cleanup: 4 pre-existing tests fail against the current (freshly-cycling) DB — they encode stale expected buy/sell counts and profit totals: test_bots_list.py::test_btcusdt_expected_counts_and_profit (expects buys=8/sells=9/profit≈443.39, reality has drifted because bots resumed cycling — the whole point of this iteration's fix), test_bots_list.py::test_dogeusdt_expected (expects buys=1/sells=0, reality now buys=39/sells=38 after 38 completed cycles), test_trading_verification.py::test_revenue_numbers_roughly_match_video (expects total_profit>=500, current is $167-$219 depending on fixture side-effects), test_roi_cleanup_bug.py::test_no_sell_row_has_profit_gte_95pct_of_amount (caused by seeded_sell fixture pollution — see minor item above). Suggest either relaxing the exact-count assertions to bounds (e.g., `buy_count >= 8`) or refreshing the expected values.

OPTIONAL: /trades page issues 5 separate Binance WSS connections per bot from the browser (btc/eth/sol/bnb/xrp/doge/uni/ada) — all fail with 451 geo-restriction and generate console errors. Consider routing WS through the backend proxy (which uses a supported region) or gracefully suppressing the fetch when the browser's location is restricted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:997-1000 & 1087-1090 — the fix is correct and mirrored in BOTH the live and demo SELL branches. Good.
server.py:1610 — unique index creation is idempotent (create_index is a no-op if identical index exists). Confirmed at runtime.
server.py still 1699 lines — same recommendation as iterations 11/12/13 to split into modules (auth, bots, engine, trades, revenue).

There is no DB-level guard preventing bots from being persisted without trade_method. Consider a Pydantic default `trade_method: Literal['Cycle','One-Shot'] = 'Cycle'` on the write path (POST /api/bots/{symbol}) so no doc can be created without an explicit value.

Trades.jsx / TradingPair.jsx browser code: the WSS calls to stream.binance.com from the user's browser will always fail in restricted regions. This is a UX pain point — the 'CONNECTING…' badge stays permanently. Consider polling /api/market/ticker as a fallback rather than showing the perpetual connecting state.

success_rate.backend: 14/14 new cycle-reset tests pass; 112/116 total in the whole suite pass (the 4 remaining failures are pre-existing stale-expectation tests documented in action_items — none are caused by iteration 14's fix).
success_rate.frontend: 100% — /trades and /pair/ADAUSDT render correctly, all key data-testids populate with expected values, only pre-existing Binance WS geo-restriction console errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-14 bug fix verified. Key artefacts: (a) /app/backend/tests/test_cycle_reset.py is THE regression harness for the cycle-reset bug — run it before any change to server.py's _execute_trade SELL path. (b) The synthetic test user 'TEST_cycle_reset_*' is created and cleaned on each run — safe. (c) 4 legacy tests fail because they encode stale expected numbers (buy_count=8/sell_count=9 for BTC, buy=1/sell=0 for DOGE, total_profit>=500). These are NOT regressions from iteration 14; they are test-data drift because the bots are once again actively cycling (which is exactly what this iteration's fix enabled). Recommend loosening those asserts to bounds. (d) The seeded_sell fixture in test_revenue_drilldown.py / test_revenue_date_drilldown.py pollutes admin's SELL rows with profit==amount — this breaks the iteration-13 ROI cleanup test. Consider isolating fixture data or scoping the ROI assertion. (e) LIVE SELL branch in server.py (~line 976) still does NOT have the avg_price<=0 guard — only the demo path (line 1063) does. Same open recommendation from iteration 13. (f) 7 bot docs across the DB (1 admin XRPUSDT + 6 test users) still have trade_method missing/null — the code fix handles this correctly (defaults to Cycle) but a one-off backfill would tidy the data. (g) Admin binance_keys.mode='demo' as required. (h) All 4 running bots (ADA/BTC/DOGE/UNI) have position_qty>0 and cycles_completed>=1.
rca of the issue: 3-fold root cause and 3-fold fix — all verified: (1) CODE (server.py:997-1000 demo path & :1087-1090 live path): the old `!= 'Cycle'` guard incorrectly stopped bots whose doc had trade_method=None/missing. Post-fix: `== 'One-Shot'` — missing/None safely defaults to Cycle behaviour. Verified by 4 direct unit tests exercising all 4 trade_method values (Cycle/One-Shot/missing/None) in the actual _execute_trade SELL demo path — only One-Shot sets status='stopped'; the other 3 leave it 'running'. (2) DATA: unique compound index on (user_id, symbol) present and enforced (DuplicateKeyError raised on synthetic duplicate insert). Admin has count=1 doc for each of ADAUSDT/BTCUSDT/DOGEUSDT/UNIUSDT — the 8 stale BTC duplicates from before are gone. (3) LIVE: binance_keys.mode='demo' for admin; supervisor log shows no 'Binance not reachable' AFTER the last successful trade line (`bot ADAUSDT: first buy $20.0 at ~0.1768`, `bot DOGEUSDT: TAKE PROFIT sold at 0.07699`, `bot DOGEUSDT: first buy $50.0 at ~0.07696` all appearing after the switch). Post-fix ADA state confirmed via API: status=running, trade_method=Cycle, position_qty=113.186191, avg_price=0.1767, cycles_completed=1 — cycle 2's first buy fired successfully. Frontend confirms the same on /trades ('ADA/USDT · Round 1 · 2 buys · 1 sells') and /pair/ADAUSDT (Trade Method=Cycle, Round=1, Buys=2, Sells=1, Position=113.186191). User's original complaint ('ADA dubara buy nahi hua') is resolved.
